notes.title: Hotfix 1.08.01
notes.notes:
Small update to fix some quality-of-life improvements for PC controllers.

PATCH
Improved direct input controller detection. This should mean issues where controllers were being picked up erroneously are reduced.
Added a configuration tool option to disable direct input controllers. If you’re still having issues, use this to disable legacy controller support.
Added an inifile option to disable the “critical control” warnings. This should aid setup in cases with unusual “joysticks”, such as headtrackers using Vjoy.
Added an inifile option for scaling the FOV from its default size. Not compatible with VR mode. Intended for advanced users only.
Added “force freelook” inifile option which causes the freelook control to stay on continuously. This should be useful for headtracking setups.

notes.title: Battlezone s free Gold Edition update makes VR headsets optional
notes.notes:
Those without fancy VR future-goggles can now enjoy the neon tank-wars of Rebellion’s Battlezone. While I’d assumed that the Gold Edition update for the game would be a separate release or some manner of paid upgrade, I’m happy to be wrong here. Today, the Gold Edition rolled out as a free update to all existing players,  opening the door to a whole new set of players.
 (more…)

notes.title: Patch 1.08 May 1st 2018
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/nvqVoEG.jpg

Patch 1.08

Main
ALL Battlezone owners will be upgraded to the GOLD edition.
Battlezone Gold will include the game, Classic Mode and all released tank skins, and bobbleheads.
This will mean that owners of the game will get all the DLC and play without VR FREE!
VR and non-VR players can play co-op together!

Updates
“Play Again” button added to the end of a campaign.
Healing shards are now present in a Nemesis Duel.
Updated Radar
Improved messaging when using team lives. (Respawn progress now slows down if being healed by an ally)
Updated weapon behaviours.
Balanced end of level rewards.
Improved AI pathfinding.
Increased chance of different environments throughout a campaign.

Bug Fixes
Radial Weapons no longer occluded by geometry.
Combo kills now retrigger in the same level.
Jets now count for combo kills.
Health shards will now return more health.
Hacker tank rebalanced.
Various smaller balance tweaks, bug fixes and performance improvements.

PC Specific
Mouse and Keyboard support added.
Text chat added.

notes.title: Patch 1.07 is now live!
notes.notes:
UPDATE

We're holding onto this patch for a bit longer while we chase some gremlins. We hope to release it in the next couple of hours, but if not... check back tomorrow!

Patch 1.07

Added support for direct input controllers which should include the vast majority of flight stick, HOTAS controllers and older gamepads. Due to the sheer variability of these controllers, customising your controls is required before attempting to play. Note that direct input controllers aren’t currently supported in classic mode - apologies for the inconvenience but we wanted to get controller support for the main game to you as soon as possible.
Further improvements to voice chat quality on Steam.
Further improvements to jet pathfinding.
Improved UI messaging when the player is dead/being revived to discourage unnecessary use of lives. We’re aware that new players aren’t always aware that campaign lives are shared and we’re hoping that this will help to discourage premature respawning.
Fixed a bug where artillery shells would sometimes split prematurely, causing them to spread more than intended.
Tweaked artillery shell splitting. This change should make artillery hit the intended target more reliably. This, coupled with the above fix, should make the higher-level artillery weapons more viable.
Fixed a bug where Steam achievement progress was not being updated.

A minor tweak sneaked into v1.06 hotfix 1 but didn’t make patch notes:

Increased time the respawn button must be held for while a player is being revived. This is intended to discourage players from respawning while they’re being revived.
